Bothbands were extremelypopularworldwide inthe1960s;this doesnot imply exactlyequal listenercounts. The pandemic passage is anchored to summer2020. Eatout/hangout questions express uncertainty,not a schedule or current invitation. Lockeddownathome contextualises watchingmovies and doesnot become a universal claim about allhouseholds.
